Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck
while the patient was turning left. The patient reports immediate onset of neck pain,
stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved
are consistent with the reported symptoms. Two office visits were completed.
Examination documented cervical paraspinal muscle tenderness, muscle spasm, and
restricted rotation and flexion. Imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue
injury, with no fracture or dislocation identified. Treatment duration was somewhat
longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this type, and the plan
included continued home exercise and anti-inflammatory medication. The patient also
has a history of treatment to the same cervical region within the past two years, and
that prior condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing
for the encounters reflects single charges per service, with no duplicate billing
noted. Diagnosis: cervical strain, acute, secondary to motor vehicle collision.
Prognosis is fair with conservative management.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
